result.summary: The page is largely consistent, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel has vertically misaligned cards: the first card (Green Bowl Poké) sits higher with its image top edge above the others, while the second and third cards are offset downward, producing a jagged, uneven row. Other elements (header, promo banner, popular list, bottom nav) render correctly.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the cards are not vertically aligned: the Green Bowl Poké card's image starts higher (top edge ~y=830) while Smash Bros Burgers and Trattoria Piccola cards start lower (~y=865), so titles and delivery fees land at different baselines and the row looks jagged/broken.
issues.suggestion: Align all carousel cards to a common top edge (e.g. align-items: flex-start on the row container) and give images a fixed height so titles, badges and prices line up across cards.

issues.description: The delivery-time badge position is inconsistent across carousel cards: on Green Bowl Poké it overlaps the bottom-left of the image, on Smash Bros Burgers it sits lower overlapping the image bottom edge, and on Trattoria Piccola it overlaps the middle-left of the image, reinforcing the misaligned appearance.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge placement (same offset from the image's bottom-left corner) on every card once the card heights are unified.
